title: Exceptional inverse image preserves global boundedness under an upper-amplitude bound
statement: Let X and Y be schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let f : X $\to$ Y admit a compactification, and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. On the ordinary unbounded étale derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], suppose an integer N satisfies: for every integer m and every L in D(X_et,$\Lambda$), L in $D^{\le m}$ implies Rf_! L in $D^{\le m+N}$. Then Rf_! is a left adjoint whose chosen right adjoint Rf^! preserves globally bounded-below objects. The left adjoint is exactly the chosen-compactification functor of lem-etale-lower-shriek-adjoint-from-compactification.

proof.text: Use lem-etale-lower-shriek-adjoint-from-compactification for the left-adjoint instance. Let K be globally bounded below and choose n with K in D^{≥n}.

If L is in D^{≤n-N-1}, the given amplitude hypothesis puts Rf_! L in D^{≤n-1}. Mathlib TStructure.zero annihilates every morphism Rf_! L → K. Transport along the inverse of rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction.homEquiv; this equivalence is injective and sends zero to zero by Adjunction.homAddEquiv_symm_zero. Thus every morphism L → Rf^! K is zero.

Apply Mathlib TStructure.isGE_iff_orthogonal at the consecutive bounds n-N-1 and n-N. This gives Rf^! K in D^{≥n-N}, and n-N is a global lower bound. Fill the plus_rightDerivedUpperShriek_obj field of HasBoundedBelowUpperShriek with this proof.
